versions.changelog:
- Updated README.md with additional documentation and explanations
- No changes to code or functionality in this release
- Improved clarity on usage, features, and autonomous payment setup

- Initial release of the cost-governor skill for OpenClaw.
- Tracks real-time LLM API costs across multiple providers.
- Enforces budget limits and includes automatic circuit breaker to stop overspending.
- Features both CLI and web dashboard interfaces.
- Supports agent-triggered autonomous payments and Pro feature unlocking via x402 protocol (0.5 USDT/month).
- Includes 7-day history and budget alerts for free tier; Pro adds unlimited history, analytics, exports, and API access.
